items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: He had Amos White and Sidney Desveen.

ctx.x: Sometimes those records don't always come out fair to the file. You know what Manion told me about Fate, I can't hardly believe it, I don't know what you think about it. He told me he's taking Fate's job on the callio. And I don't think, I can't see how Manion could qualify to take Fate's job. Did you ever hear Fate play? You never heard? I never did, except on that one record.

Maybe he had a humbug with the boss or something. It wasn't so good at one record, huh? Well no, it was all right, but it wasn't great, you know. Is that right? It wasn't great. You could do a band with him. He had Amos White and Sidney Desveen. Sidney Desveen, yes.
Sidney Desveen, he died just some time ago. He ain't been long past Sidney. No, not too long.
